trigger: Entering a car, another person driving, nearby vehicles, amusement rides, unpredictable movement
intrusive_thought: The car could roll over; there could be a crash; you or your family could die; you may fail to notice danger
feared_outcome: Death or injury to self or family in an accident
cognitive_distortion: Catastrophizing; intolerance of uncertainty; magical/superstitious thinking
compulsion: Repeating prayers/safety phrases (2x or 8x); scanning drivers; mentally simulating trajectories; seeking probability estimates

trigger: Smoking or vaping; bodily sensations; smells; thinking about long-term health
intrusive_thought: The vape could explode; your lungs may be damaged; you may die young; a sensation may indicate danger
compulsion: Smelling/checking repeatedly (nine-times patterns); body monitoring; repeating health phrases 2x; seeking medical/probabilistic reassurance

trigger: Leaving a room; going to bed; leaving home; seeing devices or lights left on
intrusive_thought: Something dangerous may happen because you were negligent; you will be responsible
feared_outcome: Fire or harm caused by your negligence
compulsion: Returning to check; waking to inspect devices; checking doors/stove/lights; mentally reconstructing what you did

trigger: Thoughts about death, danger, prayer, crossing yourself or moral responsibility
intrusive_thought: Not completing the prayer/gesture correctly could allow harm; failing to neutralise the thought may be irresponsible
feared_outcome: Causing harm by failing a moral or ritual duty
compulsion: Repeating prayers/phrases/sign of the cross to a numerical structure; mentally correcting or completing them

trigger: Opening documentation; encountering an unknown concept; using AI; seeing a notebook; beginning a difficult project
intrusive_thought: You have lost your abilities; you are no longer good at programming; you are using the wrong method; you will fail unless the plan is exact
feared_outcome: Failure, wasted time, loss of competence
compulsion: Constructing perfect plans; redesigning the learning method; checking whether AI is correct; restarting; delaying work until the method feels complete

trigger: Receiving an imperfect or ambiguous answer; knowing AI can be wrong; comparing AI output with your own work
intrusive_thought: You cannot trust the answer; using AI may have destroyed your independence; you may be deceiving yourself about what you know
feared_outcome: Believing something false; loss of independent thinking
cognitive_distortion: Intolerance of uncertainty; need for certainty; self-doubt
compulsion: Asking the same issue from different angles; requesting a final framework; cross-checking; rewriting AI output; analysing whether using AI was compulsive

trigger: Recording a thought; seeing your notebook; trying to understand the mechanism
intrusive_thought: You may have classified the thought incorrectly; you may not have identified the true trigger; the exercise may not work
feared_outcome: Getting the self-analysis wrong; the tracking failing
cognitive_distortion: Meta-worry; intolerance of uncertainty; need for certainty
compulsion: Reanalysing the entry; recording more details; checking whether the thought is 'really OCD'; asking whether you can now study without anxiety; counting/monitoring symptoms

trigger: Work deadlines; waiting for another person; unexpected delays; morning routines
intrusive_thought: You will be late; the day will be ruined; lateness proves irresponsibility or lack of control
feared_outcome: Lateness and its consequences; loss of control
cognitive_distortion: Intolerance of uncertainty; need for control; catastrophizing
compulsion: Repeated clock checking; calculating departure scenarios; mentally blaming/reviewing events; rushing; trying to control other people's timing

trigger: A coworker's tone; someone acting superior; unclear motives; conflict
intrusive_thought: You are being disrespected or manipulated; you may respond incorrectly; you may have misread the situation
feared_outcome: Being disrespected or manipulated; responding wrongly
compulsion: Replaying conversations; monitoring the person; analysing motives; searching for strategic rules; asking how a powerful/intelligent person 'should' respond

trigger: Bills; family financial instability; retail work; uncertain career progress
intrusive_thought: Your future may collapse; your work may be for nothing; you will remain trapped; your purpose may disappear
feared_outcome: Financial collapse; being trapped; loss of purpose
cognitive_distortion: Catastrophizing; need for certainty about the future
compulsion: Counting bills and euros; repeatedly forecasting outcomes; searching for a perfect exit plan; asking whether everything will become better

trigger: Being outside; waiting; lack of a defined task; unfamiliar surroundings
intrusive_thought: Something may happen while you are not prepared or attentive
feared_outcome: Being caught off guard by a threat
compulsion: Scanning the environment; checking the body; monitoring people or vehicles; remaining mentally 'on guard'

trigger: Reading; resting; losing time; comparing yourself with a more productive period
intrusive_thought: 'Do not lose this'; 'do not die'; life is short; you should already have achieved more
compulsion: Repeating thoughts; mentally reviewing life progress; refusing rest; forcing productivity; turning reading or pleasure into a performance test
compulsion_type: Rumination; compulsive productivity; avoidance of rest
